name: What are common kitchen storage solutions for small Bay Area kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What are common kitchen storage solutions for small Bay Area kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: For smaller kitchens common in the Bay Area, maximizing vertical space is key. Solutions include pull-out pantry shelves, drawer organizers for utensils and spices, corner cabinet inserts like Lazy Susans, and wall-mounted shelving or magnetic strips. Under-sink organizers can also create functional space. Custom cabinetry designed to fit challenging layouts can further optimize storage without expanding the kitchen footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common solutions for small kitchens include pull-out pantry shelves, drawer organizers, corner cabinet inserts, and wall-mounted shelving to maximize vertical space.
